programme.title: Zoé Fusée

programme.title: Dino Ranch: l'île des explorateurs

programme.title: La minute de Mike!

programme.title: Paf le chien
programme.desc: Lola a décidé d'hypnotiser son chien ; armée de son livre et de son disque hypnotique, elle se lance ; elle est dérangée par son père qui tente de préparer le repas d'anniversaire de sa femme.

programme.title: Paf le chien
programme.desc: Alors que Lola se demande quel métier elle fera plus tard, Victor lui annonce qu'au parc, il y a une petite foire de l'espace ; on y trouve une centrifugeuse, une soufflerie d'air et un espace de Benji.

programme.title: Les africanimaux d'Arthur L'aventurier

programme.title: Wowanimo

programme.title: Monde jurassique: le camp du Crétacé

programme.title: Les cochons d'Angry Birds

programme.title: Les joyeux patenteux

programme.title: L'épicerie
programme.desc: Des élèves cultivent leur pouce vert, on répond à vos questions et tour d'horizon des produits de smoked meat vendus en épicerie!

programme.desc: Une bombe qui n'a pas explosé est découverte sur un chantier naval très fréquenté; les démineurs dépêchés sur les lieux découvrent de l'argent caché et le volent; Foyle enquête sur le crime organisé dans ce secteur.

programme.title: Végétosaures
programme.desc: Ginger emprunte un raccourci avec les petits Pois-Rex pour rentrer à la maison, et ils se perdent; refusant d'admettre son erreur, Ginger leur propose de trouver un meilleur lit.

programme.title: Esme & Roy
programme.desc: Simon a hâte de célébrer l'Action de grâces; Grand-mère préparera un bon petit plat et Tillie viendra regarder le défilé avec lui; or, les choses ne se passent pas comme prévu et Simon découvre le vrai sens de cette fête.

programme.title: La Pat' Patrouille: histoires de chiots

programme.desc: Pinocchio intercepte une lettre destinée à Folet qui informe le Lutin qu'il est admis dans une lointaine et prestigieuse école.

programme.title: Petronix: les défenseurs des animaux

programme.title: L'agent Jean

programme.title: Milton's Secret
programme.desc: A man (Donald Sutherland) teaches his 11-year-old grandson (William Ainscough) how to cope with bickering parents and the neighborhood bully.

programme.title: Ever After: A Cinderella Story
programme.desc: Treated as a servant by her stepmother (Anjelica Huston), a 16th-century woman (Drew Barrymore) wins the heart of the French prince (Dougray Scott).

programme.title: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial
programme.desc: A boy's close encounter with an alien stranded on Earth leads to a unique friendship in Steven Spielberg's Oscar-winning film.

programme.title: The Hunger Games
programme.desc: A resourceful teen takes her younger sister's place in a brutal contest in which youths from each of 12 districts fight to the death on live television.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
programme.desc: After their unprecedented victory in the 74th Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen and Peeta Mellark embark on a Victors Tour. Katniss senses rebellion is stirring, but a cruel change in the upcoming 75th Hunger Games may change Panem forever.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 1
programme.desc: After shattering the games forever, Katniss (Jennifer Lawrence) finds herself in District 13, fighting to save Peeta (Josh Hutcherson) and a nation moved by her courage.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 2
programme.desc: Katniss faces mortal traps, deadly enemies and moral choices when she and her closest friends leave District 13 to assassinate President Snow and liberate the citizens of war-torn Panem.

programme.title: Outlander: Blood of my Blood
programme.desc: Ellen and Grace ride across the Highlands in search of Brian and Dougal's forces.

programme.title: Tip Toe
programme.desc: Leo suspects someone's been inside his house; when Clive brings his son Saul to work in Leo's bar, events soon reach a shocking conclusion.

programme.title: The Long Walk
programme.desc: Teens participate in a grueling high-stakes contest where they must continuously walk or be shot by a member of their military escort.

programme.title: Kanehsatake: 270 Years of Resistance
programme.desc: In 1990 a disagreement over land rights between Mohawk Indians and the Canadian government leads to a 78-day standoff.

programme.title: The Magnitude of All Things
programme.desc: When Jennifer Abbott loses her sister to cancer, her sorrow opens her up to the profound gravity of climate breakdown, and she begins to draw parallels between her grief for her sister and her grief for the climate.

programme.title: Our House
programme.desc: A science wiz creates a machine that can bring back dead loved ones, which seems like a great idea -- until the wrong spirits are unleashed.

programme.title: Cooking With Stella
programme.desc: A woman cooks for clients and tries to keep her thefts of food and money from being discovered.

programme.title: The Mask of Zorro
programme.desc: The fabled avenger trains an uncouth protégé to drive a Spanish tyrant out of California once and for all.

programme.title: The Legend of Zorro
programme.desc: The masked swordsman (Antonio Banderas) and his wife (Catherine Zeta-Jones) fight a European count (Rufus Sewell) plotting to block California's statehood.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Caped Crusader (Michael Keaton) saves dismal Gotham City and gorgeous Vicki Vale (Kim Basinger) from the freaky Joker (Jack Nicholson).

programme.title: Batman Returns
programme.desc: The Caped Crusader (Michael Keaton) clashes with Catwoman (Michelle Pfeiffer) and saves gloomy Gotham City from the foul Penguin's (Danny DeVito) plot.

programme.title: Batman Forever
programme.desc: The Caped Crusader (Val Kilmer) woos a criminal psychologist, takes on a sidekick and battles Two-Face (Tommy Lee Jones) and the Riddler (Jim Carrey).

programme.title: Batman & Robin
programme.desc: Batgirl joins the caped crusaders (George Clooney, Chris O'Donnell) to stop Mr. Freeze (Arnold Schwarzenegger) and Poison Ivy from wreaking revenge upon the world.

programme.title: Ghost Rider
programme.desc: A motorcycle stuntman who sold his soul to save a loved one becomes a fiery agent for justice at night in the presence of evil.

programme.title: Ghost Rider: Spirit of Vengeance
programme.desc: Johnny Blaze (Nicolas Cage) gets a chance to rid himself of the Ghost Rider curse forever when members of a secret church hire him to save a boy from Satan (Ciarán Hinds).

programme.title: Mary & George
programme.desc: Mary Villiers develops a cunning plan to transform her family's fortunes forever, but first she must convince her beautiful but disobedient son George to rise to the occasion and claim their destiny.

programme.title: Mary & George
programme.desc: Mary resorts to drastic measures to earn George an opportunity to impress the King; George must pull out all the stops and go head-to-head with Earl Somerset in order to stand out and prove himself to the King.

programme.title: Born to Be Blue
programme.desc: In the late 1960s, jazz trumpeter Chet Baker (Ethan Hawke) begins a romance with an actress (Carmen Ejogo) while trying to stage a musical comeback.

programme.title: Through Black Spruce
programme.desc: The disappearance of a young Cree woman in Toronto traumatizes her Northern Ontario family and sends her twin sister on a journey south to find her.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: Magnus, Will and their colleague Allison Grant are stranded when their plane goes down in a desolate mountain range; while anxiously waiting for a rescue team, the passengers fall victim to a series of deadly attacks and vivid nightmares.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: When a mating pair of abnormals is brought in for scientific study, the team begins to exhibit attractions for each other.

programme.title: Racetime
programme.desc: After losing a rigged sled race, Frankie challenges newcomer Zac to one last showdown. With the stakes higher than ever, Zac will stop at nothing to win the race.

programme.title: Annie
programme.desc: Daddy Warbucks (Albert Finney) protects little orphan Annie (Aileen Quinn) from Miss Hannigan (Carol Burnett) and crooks in Depression-era New York.

programme.title: Cairo Time
programme.desc: During a vacation in Egypt, an unexpected love affair arises between a magazine editor (Patricia Clarkson) and her husband's former colleague (Alexander Siddig).

programme.title: Step Dogs
programme.desc: Meatball, a wise cracking country dog, and Cassie, Hollywood's most pampered pet, meet when their owners get married. The two fight constantly until burglars break into their house, and they must team up to protect their home.

programme.title: Selena
programme.desc: A beautiful Mexican-American singer's (Jennifer Lopez) skyrocketing international career ends abruptly.

programme.title: Robin Hood: Prince of Thieves
programme.desc: The archer and his Moorish companion join Sherwood Forest outlaws to fight against the sheriff of Nottingham, who desires to possess Maid Marian.

programme.title: Little Women
programme.desc: Louisa May Alcott's classic story of the lives, loves and triumphs of four sisters in Civil War-era New England.

programme.title: Girl, Interrupted
programme.desc: A young woman (Winona Ryder) with a borderline personality disorder stays in a 1960s mental institution for 18 months.

programme.title: The Perks of Being a Wallflower
programme.desc: Socially awkward Charlie is a wallflower watching from the sidelines, until a pair of charismatic seniors take him under their wing.

programme.title: Mary & George
programme.desc: With Somerset keeping George on the back foot, Mary must find a way to make allies fast and overcome the Somersets or risk losing everything; Francis Bacon senses an opportunity to influence George.

programme.title: Mary & George
programme.desc: George faces a daunting trip to Scotland with an erratic and closed off King James; Mary attempts to enforce the marriage of John and Frances, but a fired-up Lady Hatton stands in her way.

programme.title: Slumber Party Massacre
programme.desc: A slumber party turns into a bloodbath, as a psychotic serial killer wielding a power drill disrupts the fun.

programme.title: Edge of the Knife
programme.desc: A tragic accident causes an anguished man to retreat deep into the forest where he is transformed into a "wild man."

programme.title: Sanctuary

programme.title: Barababor

programme.title: De garde 24/7
